Its principal user journey is reading topic-organized material, from NLP and model architecture through training, adaptation, inference, and application, with evaluation and interview questions as additional study branches. The graph groups the documented topics into learning domains; edges indicate reading, not runtime calls or a required technical pipeline. Relationships are based on the README’s table of contents; no source excerpts were provided.
